quarterly_data.signal: Microchip announced the POL-05-20S-T, a radiation-tolerant GaN-based point-of-load (POL) converter for space processing applications (new space and traditional space), now available in production quantities. It delivers up to 20A of continuous output current from a 25g surface-mount package measuring 1.51 x 1.51 x 0.45 inches, with a 4.75V to 13.2V input range and adjustable 0.7V to 5V output, for core voltage rails of FPGAs, microcontrollers, ASICs and other processing-intensive loads. Electrical parameters are specified up to a Total Ionizing Dose of 50 krad, Single Event Effects are characterized up to an LET of 43 MeV·cm²/mg, and it operates from −55°C to +100°C at full load. It extends Microchip's space power suite (EMI filters, DC-DC converters, POL regulators, Hi-Rel discretes, FPGAs and PIC64-HPSC spaceflight computing devices).
